Module com.example.miniproyecto3
Package com.example.miniproyecto3.model

Class Player

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto3.model.Player
All Implemented Interfaces:
IEliminable, IPlayable
Direct Known Subclasses:
HumanPlayer, MachinePlayer
public abstract class Player extends Object implements IPlayable, IEliminable
Abstract base class representing a player in a Cincuentazo match. Encapsulates the state common to any type of player (name, type, hand of cards, accumulated score, move count, and elimination status), leaving it to the concrete subclasses (HumanPlayer and MachinePlayer) to decide how each one selects and executes its play. Implements IPlayable (playing and drawing cards) and IEliminable (elimination state management), which allows the rest of the system (GameModel, the JavaFX controllers) to work polymorphically on Player references without knowing the concrete subclass.
Version:
1.0
Author:

    • hasValidPlay

      public boolean hasValidPlay(int tableSum)
      Determines whether the player has at least one card in hand whose value, added to the current table total, would not exceed the maximum allowed limit (GameConstants.MAX_SUM). Used to decide whether the player must be eliminated on their turn.
      Parameters:
      tableSum - the current accumulated sum on the table pile.
      Returns:
      true if at least one valid play exists; false if every card in hand would exceed the limit.

    • playCard

      public abstract void playCard(Card card, TablePile table) throws InvalidCardPlayException
      Plays a card from the player's hand onto the table pile. The concrete behavior (validations, error handling) is defined by each subclass.
      Specified by:
      playCard in interface IPlayable
      Parameters:
      card - the card to play; must belong to the player's hand.
      table - the table pile onto which the sum is accumulated.
      Throws:
